claims.claim_text: The recovery completed with unchanged scientific kernels, model weights, data and quality thresholds.
Most FIT/CAL windows admit an adequate GT-assisted single-pulse construction under the original correction bounds.
All specific compatible coarse-response/path-failure windows have a pulse witness, while the three learned checkpoints cover few of them.
Broader-function-only witnesses, certified box exclusions and unresolved cases must remain separate; none measures unpredictability.
The priority is diagnosing the observed-input-to-response learning gap, not immediately adding curve freedom; exact cause and deployable gain remain unknown.

manifest_negative_constraints: No GT in predictor forward or deployable oracle claim.
No causal decoder-root-cause, intention, SOTA, independent-generalization or irreducible-unpredictability claim.
No claim that oracle error adequacy satisfies the full motion/protection/loss gates.
No adding three seeds as independent people or changing denominators/quality thresholds.
No automatic third formal training; diagnostic leaves the response study at 2/3.
